name: Cambodia (State of Cambodia, 1989–1992)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red and blue with a yellow five-towered silhouette of Angkor Wat in the centre.
history: When the People's Republic of Kampuchea renamed itself the State of Cambodia in 1989 the lower half of its red flag became blue, keeping the yellow Angkor Wat of the 1979 flag. It was used alongside the UNTAC flag during the transition and replaced when the 1948 royal flag was readopted in June 1993.
